item.description:
Ask Pastel — on-device Q&A over your clipboard

  • Open the Library (⌘L) and press ⇧⌘A, or use the Ask button, to ask questions like “Which GitHub repos did I save?”, “Find links about AI agents” or “What did I copy this week?”.
  • Answers come from Apple Intelligence running on your Mac; nothing leaves the device. Pastel searches your history and pinboards, cites the items it used as Sources, and follow-up questions keep working (“translate the second one”).
  • Right-click any card and choose “Ask about this…” to ask about a single item, including summarising a link or explaining a code snippet.
  • Turn it off under Settings › Intelligence › Ask Pastel.

Fixes

  • Shortcut names in Settings no longer render in the active keyboard layout (e.g. Cyrillic); they always show Latin key names.

Under the hood

  • Sparkle auto-update setup is now documented in docs/sparkle-updates.md.

Pastel 0.3.2 fixes two Settings issues.

  • "Check for updates automatically" now shows Sparkle's real state instead of appearing off.
  • Accessibility: if Pastel is listed and enabled in System Settings but direct paste still doesn't work (an entry created by a differently signed build), a new "Reset & Ask Again" button in Settings › General and in the paste prompt removes the stale entry and requests access again.

Signed and notarized. Requires macOS 26 or later.
